InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error. The organization in the token could not be resolved, or an upstream dependency failed. The `description` is deliberately generic; quote `traceId` when reporting the failure.

PurchaseOrderBadRequest.description: Bad Request. The purchase order failed validation against the quote it references (`UPSTREAM_ERROR`), or the request body could not be parsed as JSON (`MALFORMED_REQUEST_BODY`). The validation rules are the ones `POST /distributor/validate-purchase-order` reports, so call that endpoint to see which rule failed.

errors.description: The access token is missing, invalid, or expired.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized. The access token is missing, invalid, or expired. The API Gateway rejects the request before it reaches the service.

errors.description: The request could not be completed

UpstreamError.description: Internal Server Error. The upstream distributor platform failed to serve the request. Only upstream `400`, `404`, and `409` responses are relayed with their own status; every other upstream failure is reported as a `500`, since it describes Jamf's problem rather than the caller's. The `description` is deliberately generic; quote `traceId` when reporting the failure.

ApiError.description: Standard Jamf error response body, returned for every non-2xx response raised by the service.

errors.description: Every problem found with the request. Always holds at least one entry.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status code of the response.

traceId.description: Trace identifier correlating the response with Jamf server-side logs. Quote it when reporting a failure. Null when the request carried no active trace.

ApiErrorItem.description: A single problem with the request.

code.description: Machine-readable, stable classification of the problem. Values used by this API include `MALFORMED_REQUEST_BODY`, `BAD_REQUEST`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `NOT_FOUND`, `UPSTREAM_ERROR`, and `INTERNAL_ERROR`. Prefer this over matching on `description`.

description.description: Human-readable explanation, for troubleshooting rather than display to an end user. Generic for server-side failures, which are correlated through `traceId` instead.
description.example: Failed to add purchase order via Skyway distributor service

field.description: Request field the problem relates to, in dotted notation for a nested field. Null when the problem is not about one field.

DistributorPurchaseOrder.description:
A distributor purchase order raised against a quote.

The schema is shared by requests and responses. On submission, supply the quote being ordered against, the distributor's own purchase order details, and the lines; the Jamf-assigned fields (`jamfPoNumber`, `jamfOrderNumber`, `orderNumber`, `status`, `createdOn`, `lastModifiedOn`, `legalEntity`) are populated by Jamf during processing and are ignored if supplied.

billingAddress.description: Address the order is billed to. Defaults to the quote's billing address when omitted.

createdOn.description: When Jamf received the purchase order. Assigned by Jamf; ignored on submission.

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code that `totalAmount` and all line amounts are denominated in. Must match the quote.

jamfOrderNumber.description: Sales order Jamf raised from this purchase order. Null until the purchase order has been processed. Assigned by Jamf; ignored on submission.

jamfPoNumber.description: Purchase order number Jamf assigned during processing. Use it to read the purchase order back. Assigned by Jamf; ignored on submission.

lastModifiedOn.description: When the purchase order last changed. Assigned by Jamf; ignored on submission.

legalEntity.description: Jamf legal entity contracting on the order. Taken from the quote; ignored on submission.

lines.description: Line items on the purchase order.

orderNumber.description: Order reference within the distributor platform. Assigned during processing; ignored on submission.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms that apply to the order.

poDate.description: Date the distributor raised the purchase order.

poNumber.description: The distributor's own purchase order number.

quoteNumber.description: Quote this purchase order is raised against, as returned by `GET /distributor/quotes/{quoteNumber}`.

shippingAddress.description: Address the order ships to. Defaults to the quote's shipping address when omitted.

status.description: Processing status of the purchase order. Assigned by Jamf; ignored on submission.

totalAmount.description: Total value of the purchase order in `currencyCode`. Validated against the quote total.

legalEntity.description: Jamf legal entity that will contract on the resulting order.

shippingAddress.description: Address the resulting order ships to.

DistributorWebhook.description: Webhook delivery settings for events raised on a distributor's purchase orders.

authType.description: How the delivery is authenticated to the distributor's endpoint, such as a bearer token or a signature header.

enabled.description: Whether Jamf delivers webhooks to `url`. When false, the remaining settings are retained but no deliveries are made.

secretName.description: Name of the header the secret is sent in.

subscribedTo.description: Event types the distributor receives. An empty list means no events are delivered even when `enabled` is true.

info.description: Deal registrations, distributor quotes, and distributor purchase orders for Jamf channel partners
info.title: Jamf Account Partners API

get.description: Returns every deal registration submitted by the partner organization resolved from the access token, including registrations that have since been denied or expired, wrapped in the standard collection envelope. The full set is returned in a single response and `totalCount` reflects it; the endpoint is not paginated. A partner with no registrations returns an empty `results` array and a `totalCount` of 0.

200.description: The deal registrations submitted by the partner organization. `results` is empty when the partner has submitted none.

get.description:
Returns the integration configuration of the distributor organization resolved from the access token: the distributor's registered name and allowed source CIDR ranges, how it is permitted to submit purchase orders, and its webhook delivery settings.

Webhook secrets are never returned — `webhook.secretValue` is always omitted from the response.

patch.description:
Updates the integration configuration of the distributor organization resolved from the access token. Only the fields present in the request body are changed; omitted fields keep their current values.

`jamfInfo` is maintained by Jamf and is ignored if supplied. Supply `webhook.secretValue` to set or rotate the secret used to sign webhook deliveries; it is write-only and is never returned by `GET /distributor/configuration`.

The response has no body — read the configuration back to confirm the result.

204.description: The configuration was updated. The response has no body.

post.description:
Submits a distributor purchase order against the quote it references. The request is validated using the same rules as `POST /distributor/validate-purchase-order`; a purchase order that fails validation is rejected.

The response has no body. Jamf assigns the `jamfPoNumber` during processing, which is not synchronous with this request — poll `GET /distributor/purchase-orders/{jamfPoNumber}` or subscribe a webhook via `PATCH /distributor/configuration` to observe the outcome.

201.description: The purchase order was created and accepted for processing. The response has no body, and no `Location` header is returned: the `jamfPoNumber` the purchase order will be addressed by is assigned during processing, after this response.

get.description: Returns a single purchase order belonging to the distributor organization resolved from the access token, including its current status, its line items, and the Jamf order it produced once one exists.

Returns a single quote issued to the distributor organization resolved from the access token, including its line items and its billing and shipping addresses. Use the returned `quoteNumber` when validating or submitting a purchase order against the quote.

post.description:
Validates a distributor purchase order against the quote it references without submitting it, and returns the outcome of each validation rule that was evaluated. Use this to surface problems before calling `POST /distributor/purchase-orders`.

A `Pass` or `Warning` result does not guarantee that submission will succeed — validation is re-run on submission.

rules.message: Purchase order total differs from the quote total by less than the permitted tolerance.

200.description: The validation outcome. A response body is returned whether or not the purchase order is valid — inspect `result` to determine validity.
